maya: Quick sync: need to align on playbook for signal-driven batching/quant recommendations tied to eval alerts. Customers are asking for runtime recs + console + API. who can join?

 dmitri: TL;DR: support three workflows: low-latency (no batch), cost-optimized (aggressive batching + int8 quant), hybrid (adaptive). Eval alerts should flag quality regressions and propose rollbacks/fallbacks.

 samira: From product: pilot customers (Acme, Nola) want non-intrusive suggestions both in Console and via API. Launch criteria: false-positive alert rate < 10%, accuracy drift detection sensitivity tuned so we don't spam, and manual-accept gating for rollouts.

 kevin: CS note: customers want a 'simulate' mode so they can see perf/cost impact before accepting recs. Also need runbook for support and CSV export of suggestions.

 eva: Eng concerns: quant profiles require a short calibration job per model; batching presets need runtime metrics to choose batch_size. MVP proposal: heuristics + light sampling calibration. Example config snippet:

 ```
 recommendation:
   policy: hybrid
   batch_size: auto
   quant_profile: int8_fast
   eval_alert_threshold: 0.03
 ```

 dmitri: Suggest explicit thresholds per metric: latency_p95, cost_per_1k_tokens, accuracy_drop. Eval-triggered flow: scheduled eval -> compare -> create alert -> generate suggestions -> customer review -> optional rollout job.

 samira: Launch checklist: public docs, SDK endpoint /v1/recommendations, Console UI card + timeline, telemetry events (rec.accepted, rec.simulated), pilot runbook, support playbook. Product sign-off + two pilots onboarded required for beta.

 maya: @dmitri @eva can you strawman effort estimates? @kevin i'll draft pilot ask to Acme/Nola. Target: alpha in 8 weeks. :calendar:

 eva: Rough estimate: calibration infra + sample jobs ~3w, runtime hooks & Console pieces ~3w, QA + pilot integration ~2w. Risks: calibration compute costs, slow eval turnaround impacting alert timeliness.

 kevin: I'll confirm pilot participants by EOD. One ask from CS: customers must be able to opt-out of automatic rollouts. :thumbsup:

 ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1234 for tracking playbook work.
